historical_references.reference: The name Hitesh is derived from the Sanskrit language, where Hite means 'sun' and Shah means 'lord' or 'ruler'. This name was popular among the Hindu warriors and rulers during the medieval period in India.

Another reference suggests that Hitesh is a variation of the name Hari-shish, where Hari is the name of the Hindu deity Vishnu and Shish means 'protector'. This name was given to those who were believed to be protectors of the Hindu religion and culture during the medieval period in India.
